mechanism: Ethinyl estradiol inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing selegiline metabolism variability and oral bioavailability, while selegiline's weak MAOI properties at low doses may have additive effects with estrogen on cardiovascular function.
action: Monitor blood pressure and cardiovascular symptoms; counsel on signs of hypertensive episodes; consider alternative contraception if selegiline dose is high (>10mg/day) or if patient develops adverse effects.
